name: Savtek Internet Services
summary: Sydney ISP (Fairfield/Wetherill Park, savtek.net; founded by Eugene Savva) that acquired Braenet ~2003 (whose only WA presence was a Wanneroo POP); no direct WA operation.

events.details: Founded by Eugene Savva in 1997 (own about page). Founder/proprietor Eugene Savva, per its own about page.

refs.label: Australian Savtek site still operating 21 Jun 2003 (redirect into its own /home pages).
By 12 Feb 2008 the domain served an unrelated Russian construction firm - the AU ISP was dead well before; window Jun 2003 - Feb 2008 brackets c. 2004-05.
Own 2002 about page names founder Eugene Savva as proprietor.
Terms name only the trading name 'Savtek Internet' throughout - no company.
